data.name: Into the Dead: Crimson Heights
data.detailed_description:
The latest in the highly successful Into the Dead franchise, Crimson Heights combines tense stealth, tactical exploration and thrilling combat in a unique VR experience. 

Please note that this is the Virtual Reality version of Into the Dead: Crimson Heights.

Step into the role of the Heights’ new superintendent as you learn the ropes, meet the building's inhabitants, and experience the terrifying origins of a major zombie outbreak. Explore the depths of the Heights, looking for supplies and weapons to protect yourself and the residents during the unfolding crisis.

As the outbreak spreads through the building, the once-safe hallways and apartments turn into a twisting cat-and-mouse maze where danger hides around every corner. Use every weapon and tool at your disposal to sneak around or eliminate zombies, and search for a way to escape the building. 

Will you save the residents trapped with you, or strike out on your own and leave them to their fates?

data.short_description: Into the Dead: Crimson Heights is a VR survival horror game set in a confined apartment building at the beginning of a devastating zombie outbreak. Sneak, explore and fight back against the undead in a desperate attempt to survive.
